text: Page count is not a validator knob: it is AgeBand.pageCount (6 at 3-4, 8 at 5-6 and 7-8, 10 at 9-10), and CatalogIntegrity rejects any blueprint whose pageCount differs from its band. Twelve pages means new 12-beat sequences, new beat_sequences.json fixtures, re-authoring roughly half the v3 corpus into a 10-20 word class (only 'paired' at 10-16 exists today), and new collision checks on a longer book. The proposal also misstates current state: 18-38 is the 5-6 per-page band only, and the 3-4 band is already 6 pages x 10-24 words. Five books from one South African programme is not enough to justify an L-sized rework; I object to engine work and would support it only as a single experimental blueprint later.
